findings.title: Triple composite incorrectly classified as an exact target

claim.quote:
"registry_title": "Key Secondary: EAIR of CEC-confirmed First Triple Composite Endpoint (Cardiovascular (CV) Death, Heart Failure (HF) Hospitalization, or Worsening of HF in Outpatients)",
"registry_type": "SECONDARY",
"target_endpoint_class": "EXACT_TARGET"

evidence.quote: Key Secondary: EAIR of CEC-confirmed First Triple Composite Endpoint (Cardiovascular (CV) Death, Heart Failure (HF) Hospitalization, or Worsening of HF in Outpatients)
**Primary** - composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization, estimand HR, intention-to-treat population, trial end / longest randomized follow-up.

findings.why_wrong: The alternative includes outpatient worsening of HF, a third component outside the registered two-component target. The classifier drops that extra component and returns EXACT_TARGET.
findings.served_effect: The served alternative is incorrectly certified as interchangeable with the primary endpoint. It was not selected for the displayed estimate, so this does not establish numerical contamination of that estimate.
findings.proposed_fixture: Load ctgov_results['NCT02468232'][4] from records.json and the configured primary_outcome. Pass its title plus description to harness.target_endpoint._classify. Assert the result is not EXACT_TARGET and records outpatient worsening as an extra component. The current read-only probe returned EXACT_TARGET with no extra components.

findings.title: Compatibility audit evaluates the composite as all-cause mortality

evidence.quote: The primary outcome was a composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for heart failure, but the trial was designed to detect a difference in the rates of death from cardiovascular causes.

At the time of study closure, the primary outcome had occurred in 914 patients (21.8%) in the LCZ696 group and 1117 patients (26.5%) in the enalapril group (hazard ratio in the LCZ696 group, 0.80; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73 to 0.87; P<0.001).

findings.why_wrong: The audit assigns the wrong outcome identity to the displayed HR 0.80. Its fallback treats any outcome name containing 'death' as all-cause mortality, ignoring the bound composite definition.
findings.served_effect: The compatibility audit falsely reports underlying endpoint heterogeneity between PARADIGM-HF and PARALLEL-HF.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the served primary outcome and its PMID 25176015 trial row as inputs to harness.compat_direction._endpoint_definition. Assert the result identifies cardiovascular death plus HF hospitalization and is not ALL_CAUSE_MORTALITY. The current read-only probe returned ALL_CAUSE_MORTALITY.

findings.title: Comparator trial count called unstated despite explicit held counts

claim.quote: "theirs_k": "not stated in the comparator abstract/full text"

evidence.quote: The present study includes 17 studies published by 19 November 2022
The composite CV outcome in patients with HFrEF was available in 10 trials.
However, our network meta‐analysis contains three SGLT2i trials and two ARNI trials

findings.why_wrong: The held full text explicitly gives overall, HFrEF composite, and ARNI trial counts. Their scopes need distinguishing, but extraction failure does not justify claiming the count is unstated.
findings.served_effect: The comparator panel hides available count information behind a false source-absence statement.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the three held count sentences as a comparator fixture. Assert the comparator builder preserves scope-labelled counts of 17 overall, 10 for the HFrEF composite network, and 2 ARNI trials, or explicitly reports unresolved count scope; it must not emit 'not stated in the comparator abstract/full text'. Current extract_meta returns no k for the held full text and triggers that fallback.

findings.title: Post hoc sex analysis assigned a primary-report role

evidence.quote: This post hoc analysis of PARADIGM-HF examined sex-based outcomes in patients with HF and reduced ejection fraction randomized to sacubitril/valsartan or enalapril.

findings.why_wrong: The held abstract explicitly identifies a post hoc analysis, but the served PARADIGM-HF family marks it as a primary report. The role classifier checks title and publication types without using this abstract statement.
findings.served_effect: The family provenance lists a secondary analysis as primary. The displayed effect still comes from PMID 25176015; no double-counting of this subgroup report was demonstrated.
findings.proposed_fixture: Pass the held PMID 40265590 record, unchanged, to harness.identity._role_from_record and the family-role builder. Assert a secondary role and preservation of family NCT01035255. The current read-only role-classifier probe returned primary.
